rows.author: H035
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING SALES TAX IN LIEU OF VALUE-ADDED TAX, REPLACING FOR THE PURPOSE THE ENTIRE PROVISIONS OF TITLE IV, AND AMENDING SECTION 116, TITLE V, AND SECTION 236, TITLE IX, OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997, AS AMENDED, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to shift to a simple sales tax system that will implement a gross taxation system.  Aims to eliminate the abuse of the input tax mechanism of the present VAT system, and simplify the monitoring and administration by the government.
Proposes to impose a lower tax rate that consumers shall pay on goods and services.
Proposes several provisions as regards persons liable to pay sales tax; rate and base of tax on the sale of goods or properties; tax on the importation of goods; tax on the sale of services and use or lease of properties; transactions exempted from the sales tax; and compliance requirements.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2020-05-12

rows.author: H058
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MEDICAL SCHOLARSHIP AND RETURN SERVICE PROGRAM FOR DESERVING STUDENTS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Medical Scholarship And Return Service (msrs) Program Act
rows.abstract:
Establishes a Medical Scholarship and Return Service (MSRS) Program for deserving students in State Universities and Colleges (SUCs) or in private higher education institutions (PHEIs) or regions where there are no SUCs offering a medical course which shall be made available for deserving Filipino students who want to pursue a degree in Doctor of Medicine.

Provides qualification requirements for applicants; conditions for the grant of scholarship; and disqualifications.

Mandates that upon passing the Physician Licensure Examination (PLE), the scholar shall be integrated into the public health and medical service system, through the DOH, and shall receive the appropriate civil service rank, salary and related benefits. Upon integration into the public health and medical system, the scholar shall render the mandatory return service for a period equivalent to at least four (4) years within six (6) years for those who have availed of four-year program, and seven (7) years for those who have availed of a five-year program.

Requires a physician who has availed of the MSRS Program but refuses to serve in a government hospital or any other local health office or refuses to comply with the mandatory return service and integration requirement to pay twice the full cost of scholarship, including other benefits and expenses incurred by reason of participation in the scholarship program.

Defines the roles and functions of CHED, SUCs and PHEIs in the implementation of the MSRS Program.
rows.status: Republic Act RA11509 enacted on 2020-12-23

rows.author: J021
rows.title_full:
AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NETWORK OF POP-UP BICYCLE LANES AND EMERGENCY
PATHWAYS FOR USE DURING THE DURATION OF THE CORONAVIRUS DISEASE 2019
(COVID-19) PANDEMIC
rows.abstract:
Aims to address the problem of transportation in preparation for the easing of quarantine restrictions to meet the demand for safe commuting of passengers which enforces social distancing measures.
Intends to promote walking and the use of bicycles and other non-motorized vehicles during the duration of the COVID-19 pandemic, especially to the frontliners and essential workers.
Seeks to create a network of safe and convenient lanes, walkways and emergency pathways that are people-oriented and pedestrian-friendly, which may be marked with removable tapes and mobile signs to connect users to essential destinations such as workplaces, medical facilities, and other similar places and most frequented destinations.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2021-03-08

rows.abstract:
Intends to create a solid and robust Philippine cyberinfrastructure that will continuously deliver reliable and fast internet connectivity that students need in this digital age.
Provides for a minimum internet speed requirement which shall be set by the NTC; and for a universal wireless internet connection access which shall be established to key areas/strategic locations which must be able to maximize
internet connectivity especially in the rural areas.
